instruction: Modify VS Code to replace tabs with 4 spaces and turn on line numbering.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to modify VS Code settings to insert spaces instead of tabs (4 spaces) and enable line numbers. The evaluator uses existing check_json_settings metric to verify all three settings are present in settings.json. No custom functions needed.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary scoring: 1.0 if all three settings are correctly configured, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator checks all three required settings (editor.insertSpaces=true, editor.tabSize=4, editor.lineNumbers='on')
Correct state extraction: get_vm_file retrieves the correct VS Code settings file (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
Correct comparison logic: check_json_settings properly verifies all expected key-value pairs exist in the settings file
Proper parameter handling: Metric correctly accesses expected['expected'] when expected.type='rule'
Robust error handling: Handles missing files and JSON parse errors gracefully
No postconfig needed: Settings.json is persistent and accessible after task completion

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
